rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — that means a lot, and five focused hours a week is genuinely useful. The most concrete thing right now: at the meetup I asked people to tell me what's neglected, and I'd like to turn that into something rigorous — a \"neglect map\" of AI safety work. Roughly: a structured dataset of problem areas (evals, incident reporting, governance, interpretability, etc.), who is actually working on each, rough headcount/funding where findable, and where the gaps are. Your data-analyst skills are a perfect fit, and it would shape everything Halcyon Threshold does next. Two honest caveats: this is very early (it's just me, evenings and weekends), and we're keeping a low public profile for a few more weeks while I sort out an employment-disclosure formality. Want to do a 30-minute call this week to scope a first slice? Tell me what times work. Morgan (sent via my assistant)"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman accepting her 5 hrs/week and proposing the Neglect Map pilot plus a 30-minute scoping call.
